verdict.rationale: The only evidence of Gide's own AI use is one generic line saying it uses technologies 'including artificial intelligence.' It names no tools, policies or firm-built AI products, so it is exactly the bare marketing mention the story excludes. The AI references on the IT, fintech and Gide 255 pages describe advising clients on AI law, not how the firm uses AI to deliver its services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
